methodology.fixedBenchmarkComparison: Rebuild current candidates and source priority with the baseline display set, holding generatedAt equal to the final product.
methodology.finalComparison: Compare the baseline product with the regenerated final display set; score changes may reflect both evidence and benchmark selection.
methodology.representatives: Filter with isMainEligibleRow, then highest overall per canonical model, tie-break profile ID; rerank eligible representatives for the displayed rank.
methodology.cells: Distinct included benchmarkId/profileId pairs with a finite normalized score; version and provenance are retained on listed cells.
methodology.inference: For existing candidate IDs, compare decideProductEffort with and without the new vendor sources. Comparison-only benchmarks are excluded as inference evidence. Actual common product evidence profile changes are listed separately.
methodology.previewMeaning: Supplement means absent from the captured organizer reference, not an independently verified measurement.

presetAvailability.reason: Anthropic release scores surviving organizer precedence are CursorBench 4.0 rows. The required Gemini 3.7 Flash has no CursorBench 4.0 cell, so no preset can include every active source and rank that required model.

selection.methodology: Role is compared first, then FULL/PARTIAL_SOURCE completeness; only equal-standing candidates use the higher-score cross-source/harness tie-break. All five listed existing-cell changes concern GPQA Diamond. The DeepSeek comparison includes a formerly winning AA PARTIAL_SOURCE candidate in the iteration before FULL Epoch and Vals candidates.
